subject: gk
question: What does "Green Revolution" mean in Indian agriculture?

options.text: Extraordinary increase in food grain production

solution:
The correct answer is __**Extraordinary increase in food grain production**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Green Revolution **signifies a significant advancement in agricultural practices aimed at enhancing production through the integration of modern tools and techniques.
 
• It marks a pivotal period in which agricultural systems transitioned into industrialized models, owing to the adoption of innovative methods such as the **utilization of high-yielding variety seeds, tractors, irrigation systems, pesticides, and fertilizers.**
 
• Prior to 1967, governmental efforts primarily focused on expanding agricultural land to meet growing food demands. However, the exponential rise in population outpaced food production, necessitating urgent measures to boost yields.
 
• This urgency culminated in the implementation of the Green Revolution, which revolutionized agricultural productivity and played a crucial role in addressing food scarcity challenges.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** has given approval for the implementation of the **Umbrella Scheme Green Revolution – 'Krishonnati Yojana' **in the agriculture sector, covering a three-year period from 2017 to 2020.
 
• This initiative includes 11 schemes aimed at fostering holistic and scientific development in the agriculture and allied sectors.
 
• The central share allocated for this scheme amounts to Rs. 33,269.976 crore. The overarching objective of the Green Revolution - Krishonnati Yojana is to enhance farmer income by boosting productivity, production, and improving returns on agricultural produce.
 
• It seeks to fortify production infrastructure, lower production costs, and facilitate the marketing of agricultural and allied products.
